fullPassage: Empathy is frequently listed as one of the most desired skills in an employer or employee, although without specifying exactly what is meant by empathy. Some businesses stress cognitive empathy, emphasizing the need for leaders to understand the perspective of employees and customers when negotiating deals and making decisions. Others stress affective empathy and empathic concern, emphasizing the ability of leaders to gain trust from employees and customers by treating them with real concern and compassion. When some consultants argue that successful companies foster empathy, what that translates to is that companies should conduct good market research. In other words, an "empathic" company understands the needs and wants of its customers and seeks to fulfill those needs and wants. When some people speak of design with empathy, what that translates to is that companies should take into account the specific needs of different populations — the blind, the deaf, the elderly, non-English speakers, the color-blind, and so on — when designing products.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (1단어) (영어로)

det.korean: 직원과 고객을 진정한 관심과 연민으로 '대우함으로써' → treating (동명사)
det.analysis: by __________ them → 전치사(by) 뒤 동명사 자리. treat(동사원형) → treating(동명사)으로 변환.

questions.passage: Empathy is frequently listed as one of the most desired skills in an employer or employee, although without specifying exactly what is meant by empathy. Some businesses stress cognitive empathy, emphasizing the need for leaders to understand the perspective of employees and customers when negotiating deals and making decisions. Others stress affective empathy and empathic concern, emphasizing the ability of leaders to gain trust from employees and customers by treating them with real concern and compassion. When some consultants argue that successful companies foster empathy, what that translates to is that companies should conduct __________. In other words, an "empathic" company understands the needs and wants of its customers and seeks to fulfill those needs and wants. When some people speak of design with empathy, what that translates to is that companies should take into account the specific needs of different populations — the blind, the deaf, the elderly, non-English speakers, the color-blind, and so on — when designing products.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 성공적인 기업이 공감을 육성한다는 것은 기업이 좋은 '시장 조사'를 수행해야 한다는 뜻이다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① real concern and compassion — 진정한 관심과 연민 (본문에 있으나 conduct ___와 어울리지 않음)
❌ ② design with empathy — 공감 디자인 (본문 뒤에 나오는 별개 맥락)
✅ ③ good market research — 좋은 시장 조사. 뒤에 고객의 필요와 욕구를 이해한다는 설명이 이어짐 ←정답
❌ ④ trust from employees — 직원들의 신뢰 (본문에 있으나 conduct ___에 부적합)
det.tip: what that translates to = 그것이 실질적으로 의미하는 바

questions.passage: Empathy is frequently listed as one of the most desired skills in an employer or employee, although without specifying exactly what is meant by empathy. Some businesses stress cognitive empathy, emphasizing the need for leaders to understand the perspective of employees and customers when negotiating deals and making decisions. Others stress affective empathy and empathic concern, emphasizing the ability of leaders to gain trust from employees and customers by treating them with real concern and compassion. When some consultants argue that successful companies foster empathy, what that translates to is that companies should conduct good market research. In other words, an "empathic" company understands the needs and wants of its customers and seeks to fulfill those needs and wants. When some people speak of design with empathy, what that translates to is that companies should __________ the specific needs of different populations — the blind, the deaf, the elderly, non-English speakers, the color-blind, and so on — when designing products.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 공감적 디자인이란 기업이 다양한 인구의 구체적인 필요를 '고려해야' 한다는 뜻이다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① argue about — ~에 대해 논쟁하다 (고객 필요에 대해 논쟁한다는 것은 문맥과 맞지 않음)
✅ ② take into account — 고려하다. 뒤에 the specific needs of different populations가 이어져 문맥에 정확히 부합 ←정답
❌ ③ speak of — ~에 대해 말하다 (본문에 있으나 뒤 문맥과 맞지 않음)
❌ ④ translate from — ~에서 번역하다 (본문의 translate to와 의미가 다름)
